# Mowgli Connect

> Free remote access to a MowgliNext robot mower's own web interface, through Cloudflare Tunnel,
> with GitHub sign-in at https://connect.bronc.app. No VPN or port forwarding.

- [Install guide for AI agents](https://bronc.app/agents.md): step by step, with the rules an agent must follow on the robot.
- [Installer script](https://bronc.app/install.sh)
- [Install guide for people](https://github.com/liltaket/mowgli-connect/blob/main/docs/install.md)
- [Source code](https://github.com/liltaket/mowgli-connect)
